 On October 29, 2026, Frosinone and Lecce will face off in the ninth round of Italy’s Serie A . Both sides will be determined to claim victory.
 Frosinone vs Lecce team news and expert analysis
 The club from the Benito Stirpe, confirming its status as a yo-yo team, earned promotion from Serie B at the end of last season. This time around, they have made a strong start: in the cup, they lost to Sassuolo only on penalties after a 1-1 draw, while in the league they have won more often than they have lost. In the latest round, they earned a draw away to Atalanta, with the match ending 3-3.
 The team from Via del Mare collected 38 points last season, which was enough to comfortably secure the “safe” 17th position. Their current campaign has also been far from convincing: they were eliminated from the cup in the summer after a 0-2 defeat to Palermo, while their Serie A record has been dominated by losses, despite a couple of victories. After unexpectedly thrashing Udinese, they were then beaten 0-2 by Juventus without a chance.
 The Serie A newcomers score 2.13 goals per match and concede 1.63. Ilič and his teammates currently have much poorer figures: 1.13 goals scored and 1.75 conceded per game.
 Previous matches: Frosinone vs Lecce 
 The visitors went nine consecutive matches without losing in regular time, winning four of those games and progressing past an opponent in the cup thanks to a goal in extra time.
 All the arguments point towards the hosts. They can win this match (odds – 1.67).
 Frosinone vs Lecce: key statistics and trends
 Frosinone have won four of their last seven Serie A matches
 50% of Frosinone’s matches have seen both teams score, with an average total of 3.75 goals per game
 Lecce have lost four of their last five matches
 25% of Lecce’s matches have seen both teams score, with an average total of 2.88 goals per game
 Frosinone vs Lecce: possible starting lineups
 Frosinone play in a 1-4-3-3 formation (possible lineup): Palmisani — Oyono, Cittadini, Calvani, Bracaglia — Kone, Mazzini, Schmid — Ghedjemis, Raimondo, Kvernadze
 Lecce play in a 1-4-3-3 formation (possible lineup): Falcone — Danilo Veiga, Siebert, Tiago Gabriel, Gallo — Coulibaly, Ilić, Maleh — Pierotti, Esteban, Fatah
